metadata.title: Dark matter distribution and dynamics of dwarf spheroidal galaxies

notes: No eligible individual stellar Galactic unbound candidates are identifiable in the supplied paper. The generic “unbound stars” discussed at T:p2-b2 are contaminants in dwarf-galaxy mass modelling, not individually identified Galactic unbound candidates. Named objects such as Fornax, Sagittarius, Carina, Andromeda II, and Phoenix are dwarf galaxies, and the disrupted systems in the simulations of Figures 1–2 are simulated dwarf galaxies rather than identified individual stars.
